author: Veopth
body:
This is something that i want and maybe a lot of people dont agree but im just suggesting c:
also idk if someone already suggest that, but, i dont care :s

Sometimes you maybe need to delete something in your backpack, or maybe you want to trade something, or give something, so, maybe sending items it will make it more easy :s

Im only giving an idea :/
or you can make a command like
/pay (credits) (player)
/balance
/give (credits) (player)
Like in the OG servers ;)

Its just and idea and it doesnt concrete
Have a nice day
